covers.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: vertical portfolio project gallery cover, 2:3 portrait composition.
Primary request: create a sophisticated, striking 3D editorial image representing a frontend developer's personal portfolio and mastery of interaction design.
Subject: a sculptural stack of precisely spaced floating interface panels, thin rounded rectangular sheets of warm ivory ceramic and smoky translucent glass, arranged in an elegant slightly twisting architectural composition; one small saturated terracotta-orange spherical element interacting with the layers. The panels are abstract and blank, with crisp beveled edges and delicate inset geometric divisions, not screenshots.
Scene/backdrop: seamless deep charcoal studio, a softly lit warm cream plinth or floor, restrained subtle shadows.
Style/medium: premium photorealistic 3D product rendering, tactile materials, exceptionally crisp contours, restrained composition, confident contemporary art direction.
Lighting/mood: warm directional studio light, soft reflections, strong readable silhouette, calm and intentional.
Color palette: charcoal #2A2F35, warm cream #f2e9d8, terracotta-orange #E5532C, subtle neutral glass and metal only.
Composition/framing: portrait full bleed, sculpture centered slightly right; must stay recognizable when cropped into a narrow vertical bar, leave upper left and lower left visually calm for live HTML labels; subject occupies the central 60%.
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, people, neon, gradients printed as UI, or unnecessary objects. Deliver one finished image, no border, no collage.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: portrait cover illustration for a technology blog in a narrow vertical project gallery, 2:3 aspect ratio.
Primary request: a very simple, tasteful sketch of one open book, blank pages and a small terracotta-orange ribbon bookmark.
Style/medium: loose confident charcoal pencil and black ink line drawing on warm ivory paper, only a few expressive lines, extremely sparse hatching, subtly imperfect hand-drawn edges. Flat editorial sketch, not a 3D render, not photorealistic.
Composition: one large recognizable open book centered slightly right, generous blank space above and below. No scene, no desk objects, no decorative extras. The book stays readable when cropped into a narrow vertical strip.
Palette: warm ivory #f2e9d8 paper, charcoal #2A2F35 strokes, one small orange #E5532C bookmark.
Constraints: keep it simple and quiet. No writing, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks or borders.
